name: image-generate-skill

metadata.description: Two standalone agent skills for image generation: img-gen (direct HTTP image generation/editing) and gpt-icon-generate (icon sheet to transparent PNG pipeline).

plugins.name: image-generate-skill
plugins.description: Generate and edit images by forwarding requests to OpenAI-Images / Gemini compatible relay sites, and turn icon sheets into transparent PNG icon packs — stdlib Python only, no MCP server.

description: Two standalone agent skills for image generation: img-gen (forwards requests to OpenAI-Images / Gemini compatible relay sites, 23 presets, ordered default chain) and gpt-icon-generate (icon sheet to transparent PNG pipeline). No MCP server, no SDK.
